name: agent-job-relay
description: Experimental durable local background jobs for Linux/Windows Desktop/Codex chats.

interface.longDescription: Run local commands independently of the chat connection and inspect durable results. Experimental same-chat completion on supported Desktop versions; requires Linux x86_64/glibc or Windows x86_64 and Node.js/npm. Desktop wake uses a private host interface. Not an official OpenAI listing. Desktop continuation depends on host version and terminal permissions; macOS and cloud execution are unsupported.
defaultPrompt: Run this project's tests in the background and tell me when they finish.
